evidenceCoverage.baselineDescription: No pre-adoption comparison is included; observations begin at adoption.
evidenceCoverage.reason: No comparable pre-adoption outcome evaluation is established for this contract.

caveat: The evidence measures post-adoption attainment only; without a comparable pre-adoption baseline it cannot establish improvement or causation.

intent.goal: Keep concurrent and sequential reusable-workflow callers isolated: each invocation uploads uniquely input-correlated artifacts whose contents and downstream consumer belong to that invocation.
intent.acceptance: All task-a/task-b concurrent and task-c sequential invocations have distinct provider artifact identities/names, SHA256-verified activation and agent payloads containing their exact declared task input, correct noop content, and source-bound protected consumer readback. All additional invocation-scoped artifact families must also be isolated when emitted.

evidence.opportunity: Every original smoke-multi-caller execution attempt invoking task-a, task-b concurrently and task-c sequentially against the assigned reusable workflow.
filters: Only source-defined smoke-multi-caller opportunities; standalone schedule/dispatch runs do not exercise multiple callers and are inventoried separately.
Initial attempts only; inventory later attempts without counting the same opportunity twice.
GitHub pull_request uses a merge checkout: missing immutable workflow execution identity remains unknown.
Source profiles preserve original caller inputs/defaults, producer/consumer steps and namespace algorithm; incompatible historical profiles remain unknown.
SHA256 namespace prefix depends on exact toJSON(inputs) serialization and run attempt. Never hash a guessed JSON serialization.
Identical-input calls are an explicitly documented unsupported edge case, not proven safe.
Jobs, successful uploads, artifact counts, task echoes and agent-authored noop text alone are not accepted outcome evidence.
evidence.collection: Offline replay of complete Actions discovery, source-bound caller/callee jobs, provider artifact digests and input-correlated payload/consumer receipts.

model.architecture: Independent artifact identity/content and protected consumer verification; missing payloads remain unknown.
model.recommendation: Do not claim collision safety, trends or retention decisions from successful jobs or artifact counts.

metrics.name: Verified isolated caller scenarios
metrics.formula: Count source-bound three-caller scenarios with distinct input-correlated artifact identities, correct payloads and protected consumer readback.

metrics.name: Complete isolated caller scenarios
metrics.formula: The same native count only if every eligible scenario in the period has accepted positive or negative evidence.
